method.scope: Four archived rank-0 traces and their formal timing reports; no new GPU experiments
method.trace_units: Chrome trace ts/dur are microseconds; reported totals/spans are milliseconds
method.cpu_duration_caution: Inclusive sums of nested cpu_op/user_annotation events overlap. Never add these sums as wall-clock time.
method.gpu_duration_caution: GPU kernel duration sums can overlap and include communication waiting. busy_union_ms merges intervals, but does not distinguish useful computation from waiting.
method.cross_host_caution: Profile has instrumentation overhead. Its durations diagnose mechanism and cannot be directly equated to unprofiled step losses. Hardware, driver, and runtime host differences remain confounded.
method.basic_baseline_choice: Use basic-quant-receiver v2; a-baseline-fusion v1 uses a different backend and numerical trajectory.
